## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn individual. He is deeply unsociable by nature, preferring solitude and independence above all else.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024)_

## History

Joshua Pye was hired to paint the hall for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). After completing the job, it was discovered that he had accidentally painted the building bright blue instead of the intended green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although his mistake devastated the society members, the incident ultimately earned them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +25 more_
